content.text:
Yes — **early Coca-Cola did contain cocaine**, because it was made with **extract from coca leaves**, the same plant cocaine is derived from.

A few key points:

- **Coca-Cola was introduced in 1886** by John Pemberton.
- The original formula included **coca leaf extract** and **kola nut extract** — hence the name **Coca-Cola**.
- At the time, cocaine was legal and commonly used in tonics and medicines.
- Coca-Cola removed cocaine from the drink in the **early 1900s**; by about **1903**, the company had moved to “decocainized” coca leaves.
- Modern Coca-Cola **does not contain cocaine**, though it has historically used flavoring derived from coca leaves after the cocaine alkaloid is removed.

So the short answer is: **yes, originally — but not today.**
